name: City Council
agenda_text:
REGULAR MEETING OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
AGENDA
Wednesday, January 28, 2015 - 06:30 p.m.
LOMITA CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS
24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA 90717
Published by the Office of the City Clerk
1.
OPENING CEREMONIES
a.
Call Meeting to Order
b.
Flag Salute
c.
Invocation - Mayor Sanchez
d.
Roll Call
2.
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
3.
PRESENTATIONS
a.
Annual Railroad Museum Foundation Presentation
Presented by Susan Dever, Railroad Museum Foundation Board Chair
4.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Persons wishing to speak on Consent Agenda items or subjects other than those scheduled are requested to do so at this time. In order to conduct a timely meeting, a five minute time limit per person has been established. Amendments to Government Code Section 54954.2
prohibit the Council from taking action or engaging in discussion on a specific item unless it appears on a posted agenda.
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS AND MEETING ATTENDANCE REPORTS FROM THE CITY COUNCIL The City Council may discuss and act upon items described under Council Comments; however, items which are not will be limited to Council reports, announcements, or requests for clarification, or factual information, or to placement of matters on the agenda for a future meeting.
6.
CITY MANAGER'S REPORT (information only)
7.
CONSENT AGENDA
All items under the Consent Agenda are considered by the Council to be routine and will be enacted by one motion in the form listed below. There may be separate discussions of these items prior to the time the Council votes on the motion. Specific items may be removed from the Consent Agenda at the request of any Councilmember or staff.
a.
Motion to Waive Further Reading
b.
Approve the Minutes of the Special and Regular City Council Meetings held on January 14, 2015
ACTION: That the minutes be approved.
Item 7b
c.
Resolution 2015-02, Approving the Demands and Payroll.
ACTION: That said resolution be adopted approving the demands and payroll.
Item 7c
d.
Consideration of Resolutions establishing a Health Reimbursement Arrangement (HRA) and Section 125 Cafeteria Plan to initiate the Public Employees' Medical and Hospital Care Act (PEMHCA) Program
ACTION: Adopt resolutions establishing:
1)
a Health Reimbursement Arrangement and;
2)
a Section 125 Cafeteria Plan to initiate the PEMCHA Program
Item 7d
PUBLIC HEARINGS:
8.
CODE AMENDMENT NO. 2015-01 MASSAGE ORDINANCE Discussion and possible introduction of first reading, an ordinance repealing and replacing Chapter 8 (Massage) of Title VI of the Lomita Municipal Code. The proposed ordinance ensures consistency with State Law and enhances the City's ability to regulate massage facilities and technicians operating within the City of Lomita.
An Ordinance of the City of the City Council of the City of Lomita, amending in its entirety Chapter 8 of Title VI of the Lomita Municipal Code related to Massage Business (First Reading)
ACTION: 1) Staff recommends that the City Council after the City Attorney reads the title, introduce on first reading an ordinance replacing Chapter 8 (Massage) of Title VI of the Lomita Municipal Code; 2) direct staff to schedule the second reading and adoption of the ordinance for the February 11, 2015 meeting.
Item 8
9.
ANNUAL PROGRESS REPORT ON THE GENERAL PLAN Discussion and possible adoption of a resolution accepting the 2014 Annual Progress Report on the General Plan.
ACTION: Staff recommends that the City Council adopt a resolution accepting the 2014 Annual Progress Report on the General Plan, and direct staff to submit the report to the State Office of Planning and Research (OPR) and the State Housing and Community Development (HCD)
Presented by Principal Planner Velasco
Item 9
10.
ADJOURNMENT The next regular meeting of the Lomita City Council will be on February 11, 2015, at 6:30 p.m.
Written materials distributed to the City Council within 72 hours of the City Council meeting are available for public inspection immediately upon distribution in the City Clerk's office at 24300 Narbonne Avenue.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, you should contact the office of the City Clerk at 310 325-7110 (voice) or the California Relay Service. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the city to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility to this meeting.
